gate_title: Measured Capacity + Stage-A Population Readiness Freeze
proposed_delta: Freeze the measured MCARB Stage-A implementation-capacity budget and accept the proposed non-executable Stage-A population eligibility candidate only. This does not authorize Stage-A market benchmark execution, ACTIVE_DISCOVERY, scientific interpretation, representation/family/threshold selection, or any downstream promotion.

acceptance_conditions.condition: Stage-A minimum population candidate identified without outcome-based selection
C0/C1 capacity measured on GitHub-hosted environment
correctable deterministic defect repaired and dependent suite rerun
no Stage-A execution or scientific interpretation

population_readiness.binding_limitation: K/L maintenance/closure coverage prevents every single month from reaching >=15 eligible days for all A-L slots.

corrective_defects.finding: Process-global Decimal precision mutation in dependence.py changed unrelated SRFD exact arithmetic when the capacity test exercised MCARB late in the full suite.
corrective_defects.resolution: Use decimal.localcontext() inside Pearson only; no global context mutation.
corrective_defects.verification: 433-test complete suite PASS and OVC FINAL_HEAD/merge-readiness PASS

warnings: The plan text states one complete UTC calendar month, but no single 2021-2024 non-Validation month meets the all-slot floor. FREEZE_STAGE_A_READINESS therefore explicitly accepts a two-contiguous-month aggregate readiness population rather than silently weakening the slot threshold.
K/L are the binding coverage limitation; this is preserved as evidence, not repaired or filled.
AL_SOURCE_PARTIAL remains binding. AL-02/03, AL-10 and AL-11/12/13 remain excluded from the initial Stage-A set.
C0/C1 timings are synthetic implementation-capacity measurements and do not establish market-data runtime or scientific utility.
The proposed population is Discovery only and intentionally preserves 2024 Development for later comparison.
unresolved_issues_after_freeze: WP7 must freeze exact ET-VAR and other VariantSpecs/normalizations/thresholds before any run.
MCARBI-G7 operator acknowledgement remains required for preregistration freeze.
MCARBI-G-STAGE-A-AUTH remains the only gate able to authorize bounded Stage-A market benchmark execution.
rollback: Preserve measurement and coverage evidence. A REDESIGN/DEFER/BLOCK decision leaves the proposed population non-executable. A later change to the frozen readiness population requires versioned supersession; no source artifact is mutated or deleted.
next_action_after_freeze: Record and merge G6 decision, then execute MCARBI-WP7 Stage-A preregistration preparation and stop at MCARBI-G7 operator acknowledgement. Do not run Stage A without separate MCARBI-G-STAGE-A-AUTH AUTHORIZE_STAGE_A.
